title: Lava Solo #021 (현무암 진홍 용암 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Slavic · 메이크업 와인 레드립 극한 · 배경 바닷가 산책로 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 50s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, high ponytail jet-black hair — full body cracked black basalt and crimson molten lava fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid volcanic rock body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a rough crust of cooled black volcanic rock broken into jagged plates, with bright glowing molten lava seeping through every crack between the plates, thick lava dripping and streaming down her body in glowing rivers that pool in glowing puddles around her feet, heat shimmer rising from her skin, nothing lying flat. Dense volcanic surface — BLAZING matte black basalt crust plates across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep crimson-red molten lava glowing in every crack, with white-hot orange veins, rough volcanic, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same black basalt and molten lava, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same black basalt and molten lava with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the volcanic figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick saturated near-black burgundy lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, deep plum-brown smoky eyes, dramatic lashes.

Background: a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height beach huts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
